companies.name: Diodes Incorporated
companies.sub: ディスクリート半導体

relations.text: Diodesは2025年4月29日に、TF Semiconductor Solutionsの約56.4%の持分をMicrochipへ最大約1760万ドル相当のMCHP株式と引き換えに売却する契約を結んだ
relations.text_en: On April 29, 2025, Diodes agreed to sell its approximate 56.4% ownership stake in TF Semiconductor Solutions, Inc. to Microchip in exchange for MCHP common stock valued at up to approximately $17.6 million

source.label: Diodes Incorporated 10-K
source.quote: On April 29, 2025, the Company entered into an agreement to sell its approximate 56.4 % ownership stake in TF Semiconductor Solutions, Inc. to Microchip Technology Incorporated (“MCHP”) in exchange for shares of MCHP common stock at a value up to approximately $ 17.6 million, subject to earnout provisions, and certain closing adjustments.

relations.text: Impinjは2025年12月22日にMicrochipと物品・サービス契約を結んだ
relations.text_en: On December 22, 2025, Impinj signed a goods and services agreement with Microchip Technology Incorporated

source.label: Impinj 10-K
source.quote: On December 22, 2025, we signed a goods and services agreement with Microchip Technology Incorporated, of which a member of our board of directors holds both an executive leadership and board of directors position.
source.note: Impinjの取締役の1人がMicrochipの役員・取締役を兼ねています。
source.note_en: An Impinj director also holds an executive and board position at Microchip.

relations.text: MicrochipはJPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A.が管理代理人を務める第2次改訂版クレジット契約(2025年3月25日付)を結んでいる
relations.text_en: Microchip has a Second Amended and Restated Credit Agreement dated March 25, 2025 with JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A. as administrative agent

source.label: Microchip Technology 10-K
source.quote: 10.4 Second Amended and Restated Credit Agreement, dated as of March 25, 2025, by and among Microchip Technology Incorporated, the lenders from time to time party thereto and JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A., as administrative agent
source.note: 資金調達のみの関係です。

relations.text: 最大の販売代理店Arrow Electronicsは、2026年度の純売上高の12%、2025年度は10%を占めた
relations.text_en: Arrow Electronics, Microchip's largest distributor, made up 12% and 10% of its net sales in fiscal 2026 and fiscal 2025, respectively

source.label: Microchip Technology 10-K
source.quote: With the exception of Arrow Electronics, our largest distributor, which made up 12% and 10% of our net sales, in fiscal 2026 and in fiscal 2025, respectively, no distributor or direct customer accounted for more than 10% of our net sales.
